_comment: Notification channel presets (H-115, H-122, design D36, S8-28a, D37-NOTIFICATIONS-3). A preset says how a channel names its senders and what only the owner can set up (OPEN-14). It holds no token and no address: those stay with the channel program or connector in the user config.

telegram.sender: the numeric user ID the bot reports for the sender
owner_actions: Create the Telegram bot and keep its token with the channel program in your user-level setup.
Map each person's Telegram user ID under identities[].senders.telegram in the user config.

slack.sender: the Slack user ID of the sender
owner_actions: Pick the Slack chat and the route (a bot program or an MCP connector) and connect it in your user-level setup.
Map each person's Slack user ID under identities[].senders.slack in the user config.

gmail.sender: the sender address, only when Gmail reports that sender authentication passed
owner_actions: Confirm the Gmail address the harness writes from and connect it in your user-level setup.
List each person's e-mail addresses under identities[].emails in the user config.
